newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CHROMECORP TO BOOST CHARGE CHROME OUTPUT.
newsitem.headline: CHROMECORP TO BOOST CHARGE CHROME OUTPUT.

text.p: Chromecorp Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had approved the construction of two additional furnaces to lift annual production of charge chrome to 600,000 tonnes a year from 440,000 by the fourth quarter of 1997.
The company said in a statement that the extra capacity at its Wonderkop facility would involve a capital requirement of approximately 173 million rand which would be financed out of cash flow.
"This decision is in line with the company's defined growth strategy, enhanced but its relationship with its global marketing agent Glencore International AG," it said.
The move reflected strong market demand, it added.
